mechanism_findings.finding: FrankEye was not merely a screenshot captioner. It combined a Retina-v8 CNN, hand-engineered HOG/color features, DINOv2 scene features, OCR, face detection and other structured visual measurements in a local CPU pipeline, and injected cleaned visual analysis into Frank's language context.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Historical evidence that perception and language context were explicitly separated by a structured visual layer before later architectural collapse into native multimodal inference.

mechanism_findings.finding: For screenshots, Project-Frankenstein explicitly removed CIFAR-10 classification because it produced useless output and replaced broad fixed-class output with screenshot-specific app/UI/OCR handling.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Negative-result foundation: a tiny fixed semantic classifier is inappropriate as broad sensor truth. Any current Micro Visual Classifier should remain a familiarity/routing layer over user-specific recurring classes, matching the current directive rather than reviving CIFAR-style authority.

mechanism_findings.finding: The v7 cleanup explicitly replaced FrankEye across visual call sites with tools/native_vision.py and Qwen3.5 native multimodal analysis. Frozen-head NativeVision base64-encodes the whole image, submits it to /v1/chat/completions and returns natural-language text; it exposes no prototype memory, learned familiarity state, calibrated open-set score, evidence tier or rollback state.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: This was a simplification/supersession of the old explicit Retina surface, not evidence that user-adaptive familiarity became unnecessary. The later architecture therefore contains a lineage gap precisely where the current FRANK 0.1 directive requires a bounded adaptive familiarity layer.

mechanism_findings.finding: Drive Digital Retina independently preserved a learned two-tier pattern dictionary, centroid-like familiarity behavior, replay loops and threshold/FPR calibration. Project-Frankenstein later collapsed general visual understanding into native Qwen vision but did not carry those explicit learned-familiarity state semantics into NativeVision.
mechanism_findings.current_mapping: Cross-source lineage supports the current dissolved-Retina design: retain native multimodal perception for broad scene semantics while preserving a separate-in-semantics but in-process Micro Visual Classifier for cheap user-specific familiarity, provenance, calibration and escalation decisions.

negative_results_and_failure_modes: CIFAR-10 screenshot classification was explicitly judged useless and removed from screenshot analysis.

A prose-only NativeVision response is insufficient by itself to satisfy the current FRANK 0.1 adaptive-learning contract because it does not expose versioned familiarity/prototype state, trusted-example provenance, open-set calibration or rollback/replay semantics.

Historical Drive Retina showed that lenient visual-similarity thresholds can inflate apparent coverage while realistic false-positive rates remain high; native multimodal prose must therefore not be used as autonomous training truth for the personal classifier.

Restoring the historical FrankEye module wholesale would also be wrong: its fixed CIFAR semantic path already had a documented screenshot-domain failure and its historical learner lacked the current GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE, candidate-shadow, rollback and user-scope contract.

evidence_supported_reuse: Preserve NativeVision/Qwen multimodal path as broad semantic/deep-perception evidence source where it proves useful.
Preserve the historical concept of structured non-language visual evidence and feature reuse rather than treating generated prose as the only visual state.
Restore only the useful familiarity lineage as MVC-0/MVC-1 semantics: frozen reusable feature -> prototype/tiny readout -> calibrated known/ambiguous/unknown routing -> deeper perception escalation.
Keep personal classifier output non-authoritative and provenance/version/rollback aware.
do_not_restore: Uncalibrated similarity thresholds as semantic truth.
Historical oracle/self-generated labels as autonomous training truth.
A separate heavyweight FrankEye cognitive service merely for architectural nostalgia.
architecture_delta.inference_not_source_fact: The most coherent current lowering is to dissolve both broad native visual inference and MVC state into the same FRANK visual path while keeping their epistemic roles distinct: native/deep perception supplies sensor-semantic evidence; MVC supplies cheap familiarity/routing. This is an architecture inference from the historical lineage plus the owner-fixed directive, not a historical implementation fact.

recommended_discriminating_tests: At H1, benchmark current Qwen native-vision-only routing against Qwen native vision plus MVC-0 prototype routing on recurring user-specific UI/object classes and realistic OOD near-neighbors.
Measure whether MVC familiarity can reduce native multimodal calls without reducing task success; preregister open-set FPR, calibration, latency, CPU/RAM, retention and rollback correctness.
Include a regression set of screenshot classes where historical CIFAR output was useless, to prevent reintroducing fixed-class semantic noise through the new MVC.
Do not use NativeVision-generated labels as GOLD/SILVER without independent provenance admission.
